rationale: The papers 2504.05561 and 2505.19967 investigate the activity-rotation relation and magnetic activity in binary red giants, which are relevant to the question of discrepancies in photometric modulation amplitudes. The Gasing Pangkah paper provides insights into rapidly rotating red giants, contributing to the understanding of the mechanisms involved.
